claim_4: The paper benchmarks gradient-estimator error for six distributions and up to 24 combinations of sampling strategy, covariate, and antithetic pairing on hard sorting and 8-neighborhood shortest-path operators.
claim_5: When Cartesian sampling is feasible, Cartesian RQMC with LOO and no antithetic pairing is within 1% of the lowest reported error; triangular noise is the paper's explicit exception, for which Latin QMC is the target.
